name: mf
description: mindfunnel — project-agnostic Claude Code session management. Four slash-command skills: /mf:setup seeds ~/.mindfunnel/ (AGENTS, SOUL, USER, PROJECT templates) and the ~/.claude/ + ~/.codex/ symlinks to the user-global personal files; /mf:prime stamps a committed project-scoped AGENTS.md + intra-repo CLAUDE.md symlink + empty PROJECT.md in the current project; /mf:dump consolidates session state into Claude Code's auto-memory dir; /mf:spinup reads it back at the start of the next session.
